title: The World's Loudest Military Marching Band
hook: The Mehter band marched into battle with giant kettledrums on camels.

scenes.text: Long before European armies marched to drums, the Ottoman Empire pioneered the world's first dedicated military marching orchestra: the Mehter.

scenes.text: They marched right behind charging infantry battalions, producing a deafening wall of sound designed for psychological warfare.
